decision.title: ADR-031: Async fraud check with timeout and fallback
decision.summary: Payments calls fraud-svc async with a 300ms timeout and fallback; supersedes ADR-017.

doc.title: ADR-031: Async fraud check with timeout and fallback
doc.body: Supersedes ADR-017. payments-api calls fraud-svc with a 300 ms timeout. On timeout it falls back to a rules-only verdict and queues the payment for asynchronous re-scoring.

chosen.text: Call fraud-svc with a 300 ms timeout and a rules-only fallback

rejected.reason: one slow dependency took checkout down

note: Ingested live on camera (Story 4) with the A3 statements; decided_at = time of ingest.
